verses.geez: ወነበቦሙ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ለሙሴ ፡ ወለአሮን ፡ ወይቤሎሙ ፤
verses.translation: And the Lord spoke to Moses and Aaron, saying,

translations.lxx: And the Lord spoke to Moses and Aaron, saying,
translations.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,
translations.ron: Grăit-a Domnul cu Moise şi Aaron şi a zis:

verses.geez:
ዝንቱ ፡ ትእዛዙ ፡ ለ(ኵሉ ፡) ሕግ ፡ ዘአዘዘ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ወይቤ ፡ ንግሮሙ ፡ ለደቂቀ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ወበሎሙ ፡
                  ያ[ም] ጽኡ ፡ ለከ ፡ አሐተ ፡ እጐልተ ፡ ቀያሐ ፡ ንጽሕተ ፡ እንተ ፡ አልባቲ ፡ ላዕሌሃ ፡ ነውረ ፡ ወእንተ ፡ ኢተወድየ ፡
                  ላዕሌሃ ፡ አርዑት ።
verses.translation: This is the constitution of the law, as the Lord has commanded, saying, Speak to the sons of Israel, and let them take for thee a red heifer without spot, which has no spot on her, and on which no yoke has been put.

translations.lxx: This is the constitution of the law, as the Lord has commanded, saying, Speak to the sons of Israel, and let them take for thee a red heifer without spot, which has no spot on her, and on which no yoke has been put.
translations.kjv: This is the ordinance of the law which the LORD hath commanded, saying, Speak unto the children of Israel, that they bring thee a red heifer without spot, wherein is no blemish, and upon which never came yoke:
translations.ron: "Iată porunca legii, pe care a dat-o Domnul, când a zis: Spune fiilor lui Israel să-ţi aducă o junincă roşie, fără meteahnă, care să nu aibă cusur şi să nu fi purtat jug;

verses.geez:
ወትሁቦ ፡ ለእልዓዛር ፡ ካህን ፡ ወይወስድዋ ፡ አፍአ ፡ እምትዕይንት ፡ ውስተ ፡ መካን ፡ ንጹሕ ፡ ወይጠብሕዋ ፡ በቅድሜሁ
                  ።
verses.translation: And thou shalt give her to Eleazar the priest; and they shall bring her out of the camp into a clean place, and shall kill her before his face.

translations.lxx: And thou shalt give her to Eleazar the priest; and they shall bring her out of the camp into a clean place, and shall kill her before his face.
translations.kjv: And ye shall give her unto Eleazar the priest, that he may bring her forth without the camp, and one shall slay her before his face:
translations.ron: Să o dai preotului Eleazar, să o scoată afară din tabără, la loc curat, şi să o junghie înaintea lui.

verses.geez: ወይነሥእ ፡ እልዓዛር ፡ እምውስተ ፡ ደማ ፡ ወይነዝኅ ፡ ቅድመ ፡ ገጻ ፡ ለደብተራ ፡ መርጡል ፡ እምነ ፡ ደማ ፡ ስብዕ ።
verses.translation: And Eleazar shall take of her blood, and sprinkle of her blood seven times in front of the tabernacle of witness.

translations.lxx: And Eleazar shall take of her blood, and sprinkle of her blood seven times in front of the tabernacle of witness.
translations.kjv: And Eleazar the priest shall take of her blood with his finger, and sprinkle of her blood directly before the tabernacle of the congregation seven times:
translations.ron: Apoi să ia preotul Eleazar din sângele ei şi să stropească cu sânge spre partea de dinainte a cortului adunării de şapte ori.

verses.geez: ወያውዕይዋ ፡ በቅድሜሁ ፡ ወማእሳኒ ፡ ወሥጋሃኒ ፡ ወደማሂ ፡ ምስለ ፡ ካዕሴሃ ፡ ወያውዕይዎ ።
verses.translation: And they shall burn her to ashes before him; and her skin and her flesh and her blood, with her dung, shall be consumed.

translations.lxx: And they shall burn her to ashes before him; and her skin and her flesh and her blood, with her dung, shall be consumed.
translations.kjv: And one shall burn the heifer in his sight; her skin, and her flesh, and her blood, with her dung, shall he burn:
translations.ron: După aceea să o ardă de tot înaintea lui; să ardă adică şi carnea şi pielea şi sângele şi necurăţenia ei.

verses.geez:
ወይነሥእ ፡ ካህን ፡ ዕፀ ፡ አርዘ ፡ ወቈጽለ ፡ ህሦጱ ፡ ወለየ ፡ ወይወድይዎ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ማእከለ ፡ እሳታ ፡ ለይእቲ ፡
                  እጐልት ።
verses.translation: And the priest shall take cedar wood and hyssop and scarlet wool, and they shall cast them into the midst of the burning of the heifer.

translations.lxx: And the priest shall take cedar wood and hyssop and scarlet wool, and they shall cast them into the midst of the burning of the heifer.
translations.kjv: And the priest shall take cedar wood, and hyssop, and scarlet, and cast it into the midst of the burning of the heifer.
translations.ron: Apoi să ia preotul lemn de cedru, isop şi aţă de lână roşie şi să le arunce pe juninca ce se arde.

verses.geez:
ወየኀፅብ ፡ አልባሲሁ ፡ ካህን ፡ ወይትኀፀብ ፡ ሥጋሁ ፡ በማይ ፡ ወእምድኅረ ፡ ዝንቱ ፡ ይበውእ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ትዕይንት ፡
                  ወርኩስ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ካህን ፡ እስከ ፡ ሰርክ ።
verses.translation: And the priest shall wash his garments, and bathe his body in water, and afterwards he shall go into the camp, and the priest shall be unclean till evening.

translations.lxx: And the priest shall wash his garments, and bathe his body in water, and afterwards he shall go into the camp, and the priest shall be unclean till evening.
translations.kjv: Then the priest shall wash his clothes, and he shall bathe his flesh in water, and afterward he shall come into the camp, and the priest shall be unclean until the even.
translations.ron: Să-şi spele preotul hainele sale, să-şi spele trupul cu apă, apoi să intre în tabără şi necurat va fi până seara.

verses.geez: ወዘአውዐያሂ ፡ የኀፅብ ፡ አልባሲሁ ፡ ወይትኀፀብ ፡ ሥጋሁ ፡ ወርኩስ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ እስከ ፡ ሰርክ ።
verses.translation: And he that burns her shall wash his garments, and bathe his body, and shall be unclean till evening.

translations.lxx: And he that burns her shall wash his garments, and bathe his body, and shall be unclean till evening.
translations.kjv: And he that burneth her shall wash his clothes in water, and bathe his flesh in water, and shall be unclean until the even.
translations.ron: Cel ce a ars-o de asemenea să-şi spele hainele sale, să-şi spele trupul cu apă şi necurat va fi până seara.

verses.geez:
ወያስተጋብኦ ፡ ብእሲ ፡ ንጹሕ ፡ ለሐመዳ ፡ ወይክዕዎ ፡ አፍአ ፡ እምትዕይንት ፡ ውስተ ፡ መካን ፡ ንጹሕ ፡ ወይከውን ፡
                  ለተዐቅቦ ፡ ለትዕይንቶሙ ፡ ለደቂቀ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ለማየ ፡ መንዝኅ ፡ የዐቅብዎ ፡ እስመ ፡ ቦቱ ፡ ያነጽሑ ።
verses.translation: And a clean man shall gather up the ashes of the heifer, and lay them up in a clean place outside the camp; and they shall be for the congregation of the children of Israel to keep: it is the water of sprinkling, a purification.

translations.lxx: And a clean man shall gather up the ashes of the heifer, and lay them up in a clean place outside the camp; and they shall be for the congregation of the children of Israel to keep: it is the water of sprinkling, a purification.
translations.kjv: And a man that is clean shall gather up the ashes of the heifer, and lay them up without the camp in a clean place, and it shall be kept for the congregation of the children of Israel for a water of separation: it is a purification for sin.
translations.ron: Un om curat să strângă cenuşa junincii, s-o pună afară din tabără la loc curat şi să se păstreze pentru obştea fiilor lui Israel, ca să se facă cu ea apă de stropire, adică apă de curăţire.

verses.geez:
ወዝክቱ ፡ ዘያስተጋብእ ፡ ሐመዳ ፡ ለይእቲ ፡ እጐልት ፡ የኀፅብ ፡ አልባሲሁ ፡ ወርኩስ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ እስከ ፡ ሰርክ ፡
                  ወይኩኖሙ ፡ ለደቂቀ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ወለግዩራን ፡ ለእለ ፡ ሀለዉ ፡ ውስቴትክሙ ፡ ማእከሌክሙ ፡ ሕግ ፡ ዘለዓለም ።
verses.translation: And he that gathers up the ashes of the heifer shall wash his garments, and shall be unclean until evening; and it shall be a perpetual statute for the children of Israel and for the strangers joined to them.

translations.lxx: And he that gathers up the ashes of the heifer shall wash his garments, and shall be unclean until evening; and it shall be a perpetual statute for the children of Israel and for the strangers joined to them.
translations.kjv: And he that gathereth the ashes of the heifer shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the even: and it shall be unto the children of Israel, and unto the stranger that sojourneth among them, for a statute for ever.
translations.ron: Cel ce a adunat cenuşa junincii să-şi spele hainele sale şi să fie necurat până seara. Aceasta să fie aşezământ veşnic pentru fiii lui Israel şi pentru străinii ce trăiesc la dânşii.

verses.geez: ወዘገሰሰ ፡ በድነ ፡ ዘኵሉ ፡ ነፍሰ ፡ ሰብእ ፡ ርኩስ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ሰቡዐ ፡ ዕለተ ።
verses.translation: He that touches the dead body of any man, shall be unclean seven days.

translations.lxx: He that touches the dead body of any man, shall be unclean seven days.
translations.kjv: He that toucheth the dead body of any man shall be unclean seven days.
translations.ron: Cel ce se va atinge de trupul mort al unui om să fie necurat şapte zile.

verses.geez:
ወከመዝ ፡ ያነጽሕ ፡ ርእሶ ፡ በሣልስት ፡ ዕለት ፡ ወበሳብዕት ፡ ዕለት ፡ ወይከውን ፡ ንጹሐ ፡ ወለእመሰ ፡ ኢያንጽሐ ፡
                  ርእሶ ፡ በሣልስትኒ ፡ ዕለት ፡ ወበሳብዕትኒ ፡ ዕለት ፡ ኢ[ይነጽሕ] ።
verses.translation: He shall be purified on the third day and the seventh day, and shall be clean; but if he be not purged on the third day and the seventh day, he shall not be clean.

translations.lxx: He shall be purified on the third day and the seventh day, and shall be clean; but if he be not purged on the third day and the seventh day, he shall not be clean.
translations.kjv: He shall purify himself with it on the third day, and on the seventh day he shall be clean: but if he purify not himself the third day, then the seventh day he shall not be clean.
translations.ron: Acesta să se cureţe cu această apă în ziua a treia şi în ziua a şaptea şi va fi curat; iar de nu se va curăţi în ziua a treia şi în ziua a şaptea, nu va fi curat.

verses.geez:
ኵሉ ፡ ዘገሰሰ ፡ በድነ ፡ ዘኵሉ ፡ ነፍሰ ፡ እጓለ ፡ እመ ፡ ሕያው ፡ ዘሞተ ፡ ወኢያንጽሐ ፡ ርእሶ ፡ አርኰሰ ፡
                  ደብተራሁ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ ለትትቀጥቀጥ ፡ ይእቲ ፡ ነፍስ ፡ እምነ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ እስመ ፡ ኢያንዝኀ ፡ ላዕሌሁ ፡ ማየ ፡
                  መንዝኅ ፡ ርኩስ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ወዓዲሁ ፡ ር[ኵሱ] ፡ ሀለወ ፡ ላዕሌሁ ።
verses.translation: Every one that touches the carcase of the person of a man, if he should have died, and the other not have been purified, has defiled the tabernacle of the Lord: that soul shall be cut off from Israel, because the water of sprinkling has not been sprinkled upon him; he is unclean; his uncleanness is yet upon him.

translations.lxx: Every one that touches the carcase of the person of a man, if he should have died, and the other not have been purified, has defiled the tabernacle of the Lord: that soul shall be cut off from Israel, because the water of sprinkling has not been sprinkled upon him; he is unclean; his uncleanness is yet upon him.
translations.kjv: Whosoever toucheth the dead body of any man that is dead, and purifieth not himself, defileth the tabernacle of the LORD; and that soul shall be cut off from Israel: because the water of separation was not sprinkled upon him, he shall be unclean; his uncleanness is yet upon him.
translations.ron: Tot cel ce sg va atinge de trupul mort al unui om şi nu se va curăţi, acela va întina locaşul Domnului; omul acela se va stârpi din Israel, căci n-a fost stropit cu apă curăţitoare şi este necurat şi necurăţia lui e încă asupra lui.

verses.geez:
ወከመዝ ፡ ሕጉ ፡ ለሰብእ ፡ ለእመቦ ፡ ዘሞተ ፡ በውስተ ፡ ቤት ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ዘቦአ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ቤት ፡ ወኵሉ ፡
                  ዘሀለወ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ቤት ፡ ርኩስ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ሰቡዐ ፡ መዋዕለ ።
verses.translation: And this is the law; if a man die in a house, every one that goes into the house, and all things in the house, shall be unclean seven days.

translations.lxx: And this is the law; if a man die in a house, every one that goes into the house, and all things in the house, shall be unclean seven days.
translations.kjv: This is the law, when a man dieth in a tent: all that come into the tent, and all that is in the tent, shall be unclean seven days.
translations.ron: Iată legea: De va muri un om într-o casă, tot cel ce va intra în casa aceea şi câte sunt în casă vor fi necurate şapte zile.

verses.geez: ወኵሉ ፡ ንዋይ ፡ ክሡት ፡ ወዘኢኮነ ፡ እሱረ ፡ ማእሰር ፡ ላዕሌሁ ፡ ርኩስ ፡ ውእቱ ።
verses.translation: And every open vessel which has not a covering bound upon it, shall be unclean.

translations.lxx: And every open vessel which has not a covering bound upon it, shall be unclean.
translations.kjv: And every open vessel, which hath no covering bound upon it, is unclean.
translations.ron: Tot vasul descoperit, care nu este legat la gură şi n-are capac pe el, este necurat.

verses.geez:
ወኵሉ ፡ ዘገሰሰ ፡ በውስተ ፡ ምድር ፡ እመኒ ፡ ቅቱለ ፡ ወእመኒ ፡ በድን ፡ አው ፡ ዐጽመ ፡ ሰብእ ፡ አው ፡ መቃብር ፡
                  ርኩስ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ሰቡዐ ፡ መዋዕለ ።
verses.translation: And every one who shall touch a man slain by violence, or a corpse, or human bone, or sepulchre, shall be unclean seven days.

translations.lxx: And every one who shall touch a man slain by violence, or a corpse, or human bone, or sepulchre, shall be unclean seven days.
translations.kjv: And whosoever toucheth one that is slain with a sword in the open fields, or a dead body, or a bone of a man, or a grave, shall be unclean seven days.
translations.ron: Tot cel ce se va atinge în câmp de cel ucis cu sabia sau de mort sau de os de om sau de mormânt va fi necurat şapte zile.

verses.geez:
ወያመጽኡ ፡ ሎቱ ፡ ለዝክቱ ፡ ርኩስ ፡ እምውስተ ፡ ሐመዳ ፡ ለእንታክቲ ፡ እንተ ፡ አውዐዩ ፡ ለአንጽሖ ፡ ወይሰውጡ ፡
                  ውስቴቱ ፡ ማየ ፡ ጥዑም ፡ በውስተ ፡ ግምዔ ።
verses.translation: And they shall take for the unclean of the burnt ashes of purification, and they shall pour upon them running water into a vessel.

translations.lxx: And they shall take for the unclean of the burnt ashes of purification, and they shall pour upon them running water into a vessel.
translations.kjv: And for an unclean person they shall take of the ashes of the burnt heifer of purification for sin, and running water shall be put thereto in a vessel:
translations.ron: Pentru cel necurat să se ia din cenuşa jertfei arse pentru curăţire şi să se toarne peste ea într-un vas apă de izvor;

verses.geez:
ወያመጽኡ ፡ ቈጽለ ፡ ህሶጱ ፡ ወይጠምዖ ፡ ብእሲ ፡ ንጹሕ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ማይ ፡ ወይነዝኅ ፡ ላዕለ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ቤት
                  ፡ [ወ] ላዕለ ፡ ንዋዩ ፡ ወላዕለ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ነፍስ ፡ ዘሀለወ ፡ ህየ ፡ ወዲበ ፡ ዘገሰሰ ፡ ዐጽመ ፡ ሰብእ ፡ ወእመኒ ፡
                  ቅቱለ ፡ ወእመኒ ፡ በድን ፡ ወእመኒ ፡ መቃብር ።
verses.translation: And a clean man shall take hyssop, and dip it into the water, and sprinkle it upon the house, and the furniture, and all the souls that are therein, and upon him that touched the human bone, or the slain man, or the corpse, or the tomb.

translations.lxx: And a clean man shall take hyssop, and dip it into the water, and sprinkle it upon the house, and the furniture, and all the souls that are therein, and upon him that touched the human bone, or the slain man, or the corpse, or the tomb.
translations.kjv: And a clean person shall take hyssop, and dip it in the water, and sprinkle it upon the tent, and upon all the vessels, and upon the persons that were there, and upon him that touched a bone, or one slain, or one dead, or a grave:
translations.ron: Apoi un om curat să ia isop, să-l moaie în apa aceea şi să stropească din ea casa, lucrurile şi oamenii câţi sunt acolo şi pe cel ce s-a atins de os de om sau de ucis sau de mort sau de mormânt.

verses.geez:
ወይነዝኆ ፡ ዘንጹሕ ፡ ለርኩስ ፡ በሣልስት ፡ ዕለት ፡ ወበሳብዕት ፡ ዕለት ፡ ወይነጽሕ ፡ በሳብዕት ፡ ዕለት ፡ ወየኀፅብ
                  ፡ አልባሲሁ ፡ ወይትኅፀብ ፡ ሥጋሁ ፡ በማይ ፡ ወርኩስ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ እስከ ፡ ሰርክ ።
verses.translation: And the clean man shall sprinkle the water on the unclean on the third day and on the seventh day, and on the seventh day he shall purify himself; and the other shall wash his garments, and bathe himself in water, and shall be unclean until evening.

translations.lxx: And the clean man shall sprinkle the water on the unclean on the third day and on the seventh day, and on the seventh day he shall purify himself; and the other shall wash his garments, and bathe himself in water, and shall be unclean until evening.
translations.kjv: And the clean person shall sprinkle upon the unclean on the third day, and on the seventh day: and on the seventh day he shall purify himself, and wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and shall be clean at even.
translations.ron: Cel curat să stropească pe cel necurat în ziua a treia şi în ziua a şaptea şi să-l cureţe în ziua a şaptea. Apoi să-şi spele hainele sale şi trupul său cu apă şi va fi necurat până seara.

verses.geez:
ወብእሲ ፡ ዘረኵሰ ፡ ወኢያንጽሐ ፡ ርእሶ ፡ ለትሠሮ ፡ ይእቲ ፡ ነፍስ ፡ እምነ ፡ ማእከለ ፡ ትዕይንት ፡ እስመ ፡
                  አርኰሰት ፡ ቅድሳቲሁ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ እስመ ፡ ማየ ፡ መንዝኅ ፡ ኢተነዝኀ ፡ ላዕሌሁ ፡ ርኩስ ፡ ውእቱ ።
verses.translation: And whatever man shall be defiled and shall not purify himself, that soul shall be cut off from the midst of the congregation, because he has defiled the holy things of the Lord, because the water of sprinkling has not been sprinkled upon him; he is unclean.

translations.lxx: And whatever man shall be defiled and shall not purify himself, that soul shall be cut off from the midst of the congregation, because he has defiled the holy things of the Lord, because the water of sprinkling has not been sprinkled upon him; he is unclean.
translations.kjv: But the man that shall be unclean, and shall not purify himself, that soul shall be cut off from among the congregation, because he hath defiled the sanctuary of the LORD: the water of separation hath not been sprinkled upon him; he is unclean.
translations.ron: Iar dacă vreun om va fi necurat şi nu se va curăţi, omul acela se va stârpi din obşte, căci a spurcat locaşul Domnului; căci nu s-a stropit cu apă curăţitoare şi este necurat.

verses.geez:
ወይኩንክሙ ፡ ሕግ ፡ ዘለዓለም ፤ ወዘይነዝኅ ፡ ማየ ፡ መንዝኅ ፡ የኀፅብ ፡ አልባሲሁ ፡ ወዘገሰሶ ፡ ለ[ማየ ፡] መንዝኅ
                  ፡ ርኩስ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ እስከ ፡ ሰርክ ።
verses.translation: And it shall be to you a perpetual statute; and he that sprinkles the water of sprinkling shall wash his garments; and he that touches the water of sprinkling shall be unclean until evening.

translations.lxx: And it shall be to you a perpetual statute; and he that sprinkles the water of sprinkling shall wash his garments; and he that touches the water of sprinkling shall be unclean until evening.
translations.kjv: And it shall be a perpetual statute unto them, that he that sprinkleth the water of separation shall wash his clothes; and he that toucheth the water of separation shall be unclean until even.
translations.ron: Acesta să fie aşezământ veşnic pentru dânşii. Cel ce a stropit cu apă curăţitoare să-şi spele hainele sale; cel ce s-a atins de apa curăţitoare va fi necurat până seara.

verses.geez: ወኵሉ ፡ ዘገሰሶ ፡ ለርኩስ ፡ ይረኵስ ፡ ወነፍስ ፡ እንተ ፡ ገሰሰቶ ፡ ርኵስት ፡ ይእቲ ፡ እስከ ፡ ሰርክ ።
verses.translation: And whatsoever the unclean man shall touch shall be unclean, and the soul that touches it shall be unclean till evening.

translations.lxx: And whatsoever the unclean man shall touch shall be unclean, and the soul that touches it shall be unclean till evening.
translations.kjv: And whatsoever the unclean person toucheth shall be unclean; and the soul that toucheth it shall be unclean until even.
translations.ron: Tot lucrul de care se va atinge cel necurat va fi necurat; şi tot ce se va atinge de acel lucru va fi necurat până seara".
